climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A Lodi sub-area in southern Sacramento and northern San Joaquin Counties, taking in the community of Clay. It is one of seven smaller areas within Lodi, which stays a single AVA.
